name: Mancatcher Trap (CR 3)
body:
Mancatcher Trap
CR 3

XP 800; Type mechanical; Notice Perception DC 20; Disable Disable Device DC 20; Trigger location; Reset manual

EFFECTS

Atk +15 melee; Damage 3d6+3 piercing damage; Additional Effects sharp jaws spring shut around the creature’s ankle and hold it immobile; the creature can escape with a successful DC 20 Disable Device check, DC 22 Escape Artist check, or DC 26 Strength check, but each escape attempt that fails by 5 or more deals 1d6 points of damage to the trapped creature.

ABOUT

These traps are designed to injure anyone trying to struggle free.
